t: 根据《爱丁堡-北安普顿条约》，英格兰承认苏格兰为独立国家。
te: By the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton, England recognises Scotland as an independent state.
dz: 苏格兰独立战争结束：根据《爱丁堡-北安普顿条约》，英格兰承认苏格兰为独立国家。
de: Wars of Scottish Independence end: By the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton, England recognises Scotland as an independent state.

t: 安提波佩·尼古拉斯五世是教皇的追索人,由威尼斯主教在罗马祝圣.
te: Antipope Nicholas V, a claimant to the papacy, is consecrated in Rome by the Bishop of Venice.
dz: 安提波佩·尼古拉斯五世是教皇的追索人,由威尼斯主教在罗马祝圣.
de: Antipope Nicholas V, a claimant to the papacy, is consecrated in Rome by the Bishop of Venice.

t: 奥克汉姆的威廉,塞塞纳的方济会公使迈克尔和另外两位方济会领导人秘密离开阿维尼翁,担心教皇约翰二…
te: William of Ockham, the Franciscan Minister-General Michael of Cesena, and two other Franciscan leaders secretly leave A…
dz: 奥克汉姆的威廉,塞塞纳的方济会公使迈克尔和另外两位方济会领导人秘密离开阿维尼翁,担心教皇约翰二十二世的死刑判决.
de: William of Ockham, the Franciscan Minister-General Michael of Cesena, and two other Franciscan leaders secretly leave Avignon, fearing a death sentence from Pope John XXII.

t: 菲利普六世被加冕为法国国王.
te: Philip VI is crowned King of France.
dz: 菲利普六世被加冕为法国国王.
de: Philip VI is crowned King of France.

t: 贡扎加家族夺取了曼图瓦公国的权力,并将统治至1708年.
te: The House of Gonzaga seizes power in the Duchy of Mantua, and will rule until 1708.
dz: 贡扎加家族夺取了曼图瓦公国的权力,并将统治至1708年.
de: The House of Gonzaga seizes power in the Duchy of Mantua, and will rule until 1708.

t: 法国军队阻止了弗拉芒农民的起义.
te: French troops stop an uprising of Flemish farmers.
dz: 卡塞尔战役:法国军队阻止了弗拉芒农民的起义.
de: Battle of Cassel: French troops stop an uprising of Flemish farmers.
